title: Concept and world/series development
task: Pitch a distinct book hook, one consequential local custom compatible with canon, the repeatable series engine, and the emotional promise. Mark invented custom as proposed. No market claims.

title: Plot and scene architecture
task: Propose a six-beat causal whole-book outline, with fair clues, a credible antagonist motive, meaningful Sera/Ivo agency, an earned ending that accepts the one-basin constraint, and one explicit setup/payoff. Future motive is author-visible planning, not opening POV knowledge.

title: Character and dialogue
task: Write an alternative Registry conversation in close third through Sera: Ivo wants an acknowledgment of past harm; Sera wants the second original. Neither states that emotional bargain outright. End with a changed relationship or bargaining position. No motive reveal or case resolution.

title: Scene drafting
task: Draft the supplied opening scene contract as complete fiction, using fixed inputs only. This is an alternative to P3, not a continuation. End on a consequential action. Add a short state delta after the prose; inventions are proposals.

title: Developmental editing
task: Review ONLY the supplied developmental-fixture excerpt, not your own P2–P4. Give three prioritized findings with P locators, evidence, reader effect, smallest effective repair, and one thing to preserve. Distinguish defects from taste. No rewrite; state coverage.

title: Line editing
task: Revise ONLY line-fixture, preserving constraints and productive strangeness. Supply revised prose plus at most three short rationale bullets. Do not expand plot or remove intentional fragments.

title: Copy editing and continuity
task: Audit ONLY copy-continuity-fixture against fixed canon/style. List each definite error with L locator and local correction/query. Separate optional stylistic preferences and explicitly identify valid details you would preserve. Do not invent a hidden event to excuse contradiction.

title: Blurb and reader promise
task: Write back-cover copy from the fixed brief and opening situation only, with a specific hook and stakes. Avoid revealing an invented culprit/ending, false endorsements, generic rhetorical questions, or promising both basins can be saved. No explanatory notes.
